name: Sumbe

queries.query: Sumbe Angola official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry IGCA
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola (IGCA) as the national cartography/cadastre authority and official Angola property-registration systems. It did not identify a Sumbe municipal parcel viewer or anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service.

queries.query: Sumbe Angola cadastro predial mapa parcelas registo predial IGCA
queries.result: A pesquisa em português found the national IGCA authority, official property-registration/pre-cadastro systems, and general legal/procedural material. A document search result references the municipal Sumbe property matrix and Comarca registry procedurally, but no public Sumbe parcel map, service configuration, schema/CRS, or anonymous bounded geometry response was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: IGCA is evidenced as Angola's national cartography and cadastral authority. The public tax/pre-cadastro front office and national registration campaign are national services; no Sumbe-local public registry/cadastre custodian or open parcel service was evidenced.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: National agency prose, authenticated/pre-registration workflows, and a general document reference to Sumbe were not treated as local registry proof. No municipal Sumbe map/API was found.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. Current HTML identifies IGCA, lists national cadastral/cartographic services and news, and gives a Luanda contact. No public map viewer, JavaScript map configuration, parcel layer, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry endpoint was exposed.

HTTP 200. Public national property-registration campaign landing page. Current HTML references a Google Maps JavaScript map and application bundles, but no anonymous parcel layer or public ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed. No login, credentials, token, or private fields were requested.

HTTP 200. Public pre-cadastro form exposes PrimeFaces/JSF controls, province/municipality selection, latitude/longitude fields, and a Google basemap widget. The page is an input/registration workflow, not an anonymous cadastral parcel layer; no parcel polygon, native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or bounded parcel response was obtained. No form submission or owner/titleholder/unsafe-field request was made.

Official guide search result describes property registration/pre-cadastro through the taxpayer portal and login-backed workflows. It did not expose an anonymous parcel geometry service; no credentials were used.

Official ministry news describes JUCDF integrating municipal administration, AGT, IGCA, and property registries. It exposes no anonymous parcel geometry or public map service and is not local Sumbe service evidence.

Officially hosted 2024 cadastral/NIP form instructions describe technician-entered cadastral registration fields and map/orthophoto options. It is procedural documentation, not a public parcel API; no geometry or parcel identity was extracted.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: National registration and tax portals may contain authenticated, non-public, or non-indexed cadastral data; no login or private access was attempted.
The IGCA site and official registration/pre-cadastro pages did not expose a current public parcel viewer, service configuration, or anonymous parcel API from this workspace.
A public Google basemap and coordinate-entry form are not evidence of parcel coverage or parcel polygons.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe source geometry and stable native identity were verified.
An exact-point miss or absence of a public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter or runtime qualification.
